Data.title: Resident Working Persons Aged 15 Years and Over by Usual Mode of Transport to Work, Monthly Household Income from Work and Sex
Data.footnote: Notes:Data exclude working persons who were full-time students or overseas for more than 6 months. Full-time students are covered in the tables on usual transport to school.Income from work includes employer CPF contributions.Data on income from work have been updated to include Additional MediSave Contributions from employers with the release of the Key Household Income Trends 2025 report in February 2026. For more information, you may refer to the Technical Note on Household Income (https://go.gov.sg/khit2025-tech-note) which explains the concepts and components of our household income coverage.
